title: CLCON/13/2007 of HIMANSHU JOSHI Vs S.RAJU

paras.text:
CLCON No. 13 of 2007
Hon'ble B.S. Verma,J
 Heard Sri Alok Mehra, Advocate holding
brief of Sri Manoj Tiwari, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
 By means of this contempt petition, the
petitioners have prayed to punish the respondents
for flouting the judgment and order dated 21-4-
2006, passed by this Court in Writ Petition
No. 119 (S/S) of 2006 Uttaranchal Government
Degree College Non Teaching Employees
Association Vs. State or Uttaranchal and others,
which has been stayed in Special Appeal.
 In view of this fact, the contempt
petition is dismissed at this stage.
 The contempt petition is dismissed as
infructuous.
 Notices are hereby discharged.
 However, the petitioner will be at liberty
to file fresh petition, if cause of action survives
in future.
